English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake Statue of Lord Shiva on ocean bed AI-generated False A video featuring a statue of Lord Shiva submerged in the depths of the ocean has been making waves across X recently. The video is accompanied by the phrase, "The great ocean bows to the eternal Dharma of Shiva...,” (translated) further adding to its allure. by Anonymous | December 30, 2024 In an effort to verify the authenticity of the statue, Fact Seeker conducted an investigation. However, no evidence supporting the existence of such a site with a submerged statue of Lord Shiva could be found online. Further analysis revealed that the video was, in fact, AI-generated, shared by the X account @poongodiSugandh. However, some individuals continue to believe in the video’s authenticity, as seen in the comments section. Additionally, Fact Seeker identified a statue of Lord Buddha in the ocean floor, which shares striking similarities with the statue featured in the video. Both images exhibit comparable colors and quality, leading to the conclusion that they were both generated using the AI tool Midjorney. Accordingly, Fact Seeker confirms that the video of the Shiva statue on the deep bed circulating on social media is, AI-generated.
